entries.34b9f603ec58cfbd: A company that provides "CLOMO," an MDM service for centrally managing corporate mobile devices, and also makes startup investments through a CVC.
entries.39819f3d1d4d324a: This business develops and provides mobile device applications such as “CLOMO SECURED APPs,” centered on “CLOMO MDM,” a service that centrally manages and operates corporate mobile devices (smartphones such as iPhone and Android, tablets and mobile PCs). These services are provided via the cloud on a flat-rate subscription basis, billed monthly or annually. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended June 2026 was ¥4,440 million, accounting for all consolidated revenue.
entries.3c9a432da0158375: This segment includes optional services for CLOMO MDM and the “TRUST DELETE” information leakage prevention service for Windows PCs, provided by consolidated subsidiary Wanbi Inc. Revenue for the fiscal year ended June 2026 was ¥814 million.

entries.ae8701292db24dd2: This is an MDM service that centrally manages and operates large numbers of smartphones and tablets. It provides functions such as usage monitoring, operational efficiency improvement, device locking and data erasure in case of theft or loss, and also offers an app distribution portal and various optional services. It also provides OEM supply for the MDM service offered by NTT Docomo, Inc. Revenue for the fiscal year ended June 2026 was ¥3,467 million.

entries.cd4f16325e9b4616: This service provides five business applications (browser, email, scheduling, address book and file sharing), balancing security and ease of use. It also supports personally owned devices on which MDM cannot be mandatorily installed. Revenue for the fiscal year ended June 2026 was ¥158 million.
entries.debcd52df252bed2: Through i Cubed Ventures Inc., a venture capital subsidiary, this business establishes the “i Cubed No. 1 Investment Limited Liability Partnership” and makes startup investments. Its main investment targets are companies in mobile, SaaS and security fields with high affinity to the company group’s business domains, companies working to solve social issues, and companies active in the local Kyushu region. There was no revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended June 2026.
